items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I left here and went to Baton Rouge with Titt Johnson's off string.

ctx.x: How long were you with Tom Alvin? How many years?

I was with Tom for about, let's say five, six years. Matter of fact, I was with him from 1918 up to 1924. 1924. 1924, I got married in 1923. 1924, I left here and went to Baton Rouge with Titt Johnson's off string. He had one of the leading bands outside of New Orleans. It was Bud Scott out of Natchez, and Williams out of Napoleonville, Donisonville.
What was Bud Scott playing at the time? Which instruments?
